_about: Reader-facing places. Claude-owned. x/y are map coordinates in the site's 400x300 map; on_page means the name has appeared in saga/chronicle/. Descriptions must be supported by the chronicle. Map-only places (on_page false) show as names on the map and nothing else. Optional per place: label (map text, defaults to name), anchor (start|middle|end for region labels), label_below (true puts a marker's label under it), draw:false (no marker). route is a list of place ids or [x, y] waypoints. Optional picture (only for a place already on the page): image (a path under saga/art/, e.g. places/<id>.webp), image_alt (what it shows, for screen readers), image_caption, and image_focus ("50% 50%": the centre of the 16:9 crop); the site shows it in the codex entry, tap to enlarge.

places.name: Saint Ysolde's
places.subtitle: the House of Menders
places.description: The House of Menders at the top of the Thousand Steps, which takes the ones the lowland surgeons cannot fix and do not want to watch. Bells ring the hours; the air smells of snow and sulphur and boiled linen. Its infirmary hall is a long double row of cots, and the far ones hold the ones who no longer speak.
places.image_alt: Saint Ysolde's: a grey stone house with a bell tower and lit windows on a snowy cliff above a sea of cloud, the Thousand Steps switchbacking down the cliff face, jagged snow peaks behind, and a thin road crossing a white valley far below.
places.image_caption: Saint Ysolde's above the cloud, and the Thousand Steps below it.

places.name: The Thousand Steps
places.description: The switchback stair cut into the cliff below Saint Ysolde's, with cloud on one side and a wind that comes round the shoulder of the mountain with a knife in it. Everyone says a thousand. Wren has counted eleven hundred and seventeen.

places.name: Coldmere
places.description: A place below the mountain with an inn, where the Confessors' list of the Faithless was read aloud; the news climbed to the House by carter, lay brother and kitchen.

places.name: The Holloway
places.subtitle: the road
places.description: The road below the Steps, a brown thread across a white field from the infirmary window. Six grey riders and a cart were on it, with a smudge of smoke above them.

places.name: The Lowmarch
places.description: Darrow's country: he had the fastest feet in it, and its children count the lances in a rhyme. Its villages have bell-houses, from whose steps the Crown's heralds read that the Grace had left the knights of Harrow Ford, and its surgeons sent him north.

places.name: The river Wend
places.description: Cold and fast, brown with three days of rain off the hills at midsummer. It carried the Ninth downstream like driftwood.
places.label: The Wend

places.name: Harrow Ford
places.description: A crossing of the Wend at the edge of the Thornwild, with standing stones on the far bank. Here, halfway across, the Grace went out of the Ninth, and Darrow's knee gave way with no blade near it.

places.name: The Thornwild
places.description: The forest beyond the far bank of the Wend, home of the clans. In the dark under its trees a line of grey, armored figures stood very still while the river screamed.

places.name: Calden
places.description: Where the Oathspire stands, and where the Faithless are told they may kneel anew. Somewhere in a warm room there, Darrow believes, his name was written first on a list.

places.name: The Oathspire
places.subtitle: in Calden
places.description: In Calden. The heralds say the Faithless will be received there with mercy and permitted to kneel anew; Maelis calls that the Crown's way, and fast.

places.name: Edgemoor
places.description: The place in Darrow's name as the Reckoning writes it: Ser Darrow of Edgemoor.

places.name: The Greywater
places.description: The mountains north of the Lowmarch into which the surgeons sent him; Saint Ysolde's stands above the cloud on a shoulder of them.
places.label: The Greywater
